name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $95.8 on 13 Nov, up 3.5% on the week but 13% lower on the month; inside the Watch band
state: Brent closed near $95.8 on 13 Nov, 3.5% higher on the week but 12.8% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band and 19% below its 52-week high of $118 (Yahoo Finance). Iranian state TV said three tankers hit mines near Hormuz on 14 Nov, claims that are unverified, keeping supply concerns alive (AP). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Oil prices remain elevated, which tends to keep fuel, heating and transport costs high over the following weeks.

sources.title: AP via KSAT — Israeli drone strike kills 2 Palestinians in Gaza, and other Mideast news

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
